meta.suite: v5: wet-ink sliding-window frontier decoder (OUR idea §2.1) on LLaDA2.2's own formulas; baselines from v4b
meta.idea: frontier opens ONE token/step left-to-right; trailing window W stays editable via the model's trained T2T gate; hard dry edge at distance W (ink dries)

components.frontier: AR commit of leftmost mask (BD3-LM / Set Diffusion spectrum end; our schedule)
components.revision: LLaDA2.2 trained T2T gate p0>editing_threshold & old!=x0 (L-EBPO), windowed to [f-W, f)

meta.v4b_baselines: stock_b32 / noedit_b32 / edit0.5/0.7 from the completed v4b run (results_v4.json); paired offline
meta.rules: no self-invented formulas; combining published formulas + code from any architectures allowed after compatibility check; goal = implement the owner's wet-ink idea most effectively (rules clarified 7 Nov 2026)

Natalia sold **48 clips** in April.

In May, she sold **half as many** as in April:

$$
\frac{1}{2} \times 48 = 24 \text{ clips}
$$

Now, add the clips sold in April and May:

$$
48 + 24 = 72
$$

**Answer:** Natalia sold **72 clips** altogether
